title: Distributed work queue
learning_objectives: Propose and revise an inspectable architecture
problem_statement: Move background email jobs out of the request path and keep pending work recoverable when workers crash.

progressive_constraints.title: Durable pending work
progressive_constraints.description: Separate job admission from side effects and state where unacknowledged work survives.

progressive_constraints.title: Worker capacity
progressive_constraints.description: Use a declared service-rate model; require utilization at or below 80 percent.

progressive_constraints.title: Crash after effect
progressive_constraints.description: A worker sends email then dies before acknowledging. State duplicate prevention and lease/visibility recovery.

progressive_constraints.title: Poison jobs and fairness
progressive_constraints.description: A failing tenant must not starve all other jobs; retries need a bound and inspectable terminal handling.

valid_architecture_families.name: Durable broker and worker pool
valid_architecture_families.description: A broker retains unacknowledged jobs; idempotency bounds repeated effects.

valid_architecture_families.name: Database outbox
valid_architecture_families.description: Transactional outbox rows plus bounded leased polling can avoid a separate broker at an explicitly modeled load.

common_misconceptions: A Python list in a crashed API process is not durable pending work.
Acknowledgement is not atomic with an external email send.
More workers can overload a downstream provider without a concurrency limit.

hint_ladder.level_1: Find the point at which the API can acknowledge durable acceptance.
hint_ladder.level_2: Compare broker visibility timeouts with database job leases.
hint_ladder.level_3: A crash after sending but before acknowledgement can produce another delivery. Keep a durable job identity, make the effect idempotent where possible, and let an expired lease recover the job.

consolidation: Queue stability is a capacity claim under declared service rates, not measured throughput. Durable acceptance, lease recovery, idempotent effects and fairness are separate requirements.
fresh_transfer_question: How would you preserve fairness if one customer uploads a million jobs while others submit ten each?
coach_instructions: One clear question at a time. Inspect actual graph and stated assumptions. Do not grade prose by keywords or require a vendor name. Numeric assumptions are learner declarations, not measured performance. Explain when asked, require teach-back, and preserve alternative valid designs. Do not silently edit the diagram.
